QuestInfo.name: [Verne Mine] Gabrielle's Request 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2154004##k, who is being held hostage at the #b#m310050000##k in the mine, has something to say.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154004# says she would like to help the town any way she can while being held hostage. Lately, she's been eavesdropping on the Black Wings' conversation and collecting information.

According to what she's heard, #r#o7150004##k has a built-in chip, and by studying this chip, she says the Black Wings's technology can be revealed. Gather #b#t4032768##k as a favor to #p2154004#.
